{{Quote|No! Fight! I am deflecting their salvos&hellip; with the Force!|Master [[Thon]] to [[Nomi Sunrider]]|<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Force Deflection''', also known as '''Rebuke''', was a Force power used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were without a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], or chose not to carry one. It took much skill in the Force to use this, however, most Jedi used their lightsabers instead to deflect incoming attacks.

==Notable uses==
[[File:KenobiDeflectingDurgeAttack-SWCW8.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using Force Deflection to block [[Durge/Legends|Durge's]] attack.]]
While training with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Thon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], [[Nomi Sunrider]], her daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]] and [[Thon]] were attacked by [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. When the thugs fired upon Thon and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] from their hovercraft, the [[Tchuukthai]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was able to use the Force and repel the incoming salvo bombardment.<ref name="TOTJA" />

Nomi Sunrider used this ability to deflect a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt barehanded.<ref name="The Freedon Nadd Uprising">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref>

During the [[Old Republic era]], some years after the [[First Jedi Purge]], Jedi Knight [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] used this Force power to hold in and deflect [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] from the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Nyriss]], tearing her body apart into ashes. He would also use it again against the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] lightning during his fight against him, turning one of Tenebare's bolts back on him.<ref name="The Old Republic: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>

[[File:Yoda_Dooku_EGTF.jpg|thumb|250px|Yoda using Force deflection]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] confronted [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], secretly the Sith Lord Darth Tyranus, in a hanger on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Tyranus fired a blast of Force lightning at his former master. Yoda deflected the blast back at Tyranus, who in turn used the Force to deflect the blast into the ceiling of the hanger.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Yoda would use the Force to repel and cage Sith lightning bolts later in life, defending himself from killing blasts of blue fury flung from the hands of Palpatine, such as when he disarmed and almost killed the Sith,<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' {{C|junior novelization}}]]</ref> and when the Dark Lord and he clashed in a Senate pod, leading to the warriors being flung apart.<ref name=":0">{{Film|III}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] also used this ability during a fight with [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] to deflect projectiles from his [[gatling gauntlet]], and again later against a group of [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="TSW3">''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]''</ref> He was locked into a similar situation on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], when he and Darth Vader fought each other with thrusting Force,<ref name=":0" /> and the Sith flung blasting pulses of the dark side at him, which he turned aside.<ref>[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' {{C|novelization}}]]</ref>

During the [[Battle of Hypori/Legends|Battle of Hypori]] Shaak Ti deflected a lightsaber blow from General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] using this ability. She must have not quite mastered this ability yet, since the blow was so strong, the kinetic energy blasted her off her feet and into a wall of wreckage.<ref name="TSW3" />

[[Galen Marek]] used this ability when the reach of his lightsaber is not sufficient to block incoming blaster fire in which he imbued his free hand with the Force to deflect them; notably he also used it against [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], combined with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to protect [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] from being shocked, allowing him and the other rebels to board the [[Rogue Shadow]] and escape. While deflecting the lightning, Galen then unleashed a huge Force Explosion, not only burning the whole Observation Tower, but killing himself in the process and somewhat staggering Sidious.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

Jedi Master Rahm Kota was skilled in this ability, as seen at the start of his duel with Galen Marek when he was able to easily deflect the lightning the Sith apprentice had unleashed back to its source, as well as deflecting Marek's Force push back at him. Kota even made Marek choke himself at the same time as he choked the Jedi Master.<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] dueled his father, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], in the [[Temple of Pomojema]] on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], Vader fired a [[Kinetite/Legends|ball of kinetic energy]] at Luke. Luke was able to use this power and redirect it towards the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], even though he had little training with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SOTME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>

Darth Vader may have used this ability to deflect blaster fire from [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref> However, Luke Skywalker believed that in this incident, Vader used the ability known as [[Tutaminis|Force Absorb]] to absorb the incoming fire, and redirected the energy thus absorbed to pull the blaster out of Solo's hand.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> He was witnessed using this ability for certain at an earlier date during a coup orchestrated by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]] to deflect the blaster bolts of the Moff's traitorous stormtroopers.<ref name="SWE1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref>

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] used this ability at the [[Battle of Snevu]] during the [[Swarm War]]; holding his hand above his head, he deflected cannon fire from a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] as though he held a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].<ref name="TSW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Jacen also used this ability to deflect [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]'s blaster shots on the [[Centerpoint Station]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

During the [[Confrontation in the Caverns of the Hidden One]] Luke Skywalker used the Force to deflect a powerful whirlwind summoned by the Hidden One.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the Star Wars Revised d20 RPG, this skill is referred to as "Block" and normally cannot be used without some sort of protective gear or an item that can withstand the attack (though there are exceptions).

The Saga revision split this power into "Rebuke", allowing the user to resist, deflect, and possibly reflect back Force powers ("Force duels"), and "Negate energy" allowing the user to dissipate and possibly absorb energy attacks (the barehanded deflect).

In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', the player can use Force push to give a similar power to this against projectiles. In the latter game, however, blaster bolts cannot be deflected with the Force, only physical bullets/balls/rockets.
